Spectacular garden setting, moments to every convenience, including schools and train station, this custom built Modern Colonial features well designed spaces with attention to every detail. An entry with soaring ceiling and upper Palladian-style window fills the room with light and flows easily to each of the other living spaces. Marvin windows. Multiple French doors create garden and terrace entry. Work at home in the private office with custom cherry cabinetry. Effortless entertaining with Family Rm with tall ceiling, soaring fieldstone fireplace and multiple indoor and outdoor dining. Gourmet kitchen and butler’s pantry. Master suite with gabled ceiling, onyx bath and full gym. Additional 3 bedrooms, 1 en-suite and 2 with a tandem bath share a large balcony. Media room/possible 5th bedroom. Ever blooming gardens with specimens, free form pool with spa, stone and flagstone terrace with built in grill, a 2-hole putting green, sparkling pond and 3 garages with porte cochere entry and tumbled block courtyard.
